steps.en: The individual logs in with Singpass
MyInfo data is requested automatically after notices are chosen
steps.id: Data MyInfo diminta otomatis setelah notice dipilih

steps.en: The system fetches the person's data from MyInfo
steps.id: Sistem mengambil data orang tersebut dari MyInfo

steps.en: Name, mobile number and email are filled in from MyInfo
steps.id: Nama, nomor HP dan email terisi dari MyInfo

steps.en: The user's ID number is filled in and shown
steps.id: Nomor ID user terisi dan terlihat
steps.why_en: The ID number is taken from the login, but it is not shown on the form.
steps.why_id: Nomor ID diambil dari login, tapi tidak ditampilkan di form.
